articles.headline: Crystal Palace forced to settle for draw at 10-man Besiktas
articles.description: Jean-Philippe Mateta scored on his first start since the opening day but Crystal Palace could not capitalise on a Besiktas red card to produce a winner in their 2-2 Europa League draw in Istanbul.
